note: Wormhole bridge, 2022-02-02 18:24:13 UTC. The forged VAA is honoured and 120,000 unbacked wETH is minted to the attacker. The transaction the whole incident turns on.
Wormhole, 18:25:26 UTC. First 10,000 wETH sent back across the bridge to Ethereum.
Wormhole, 18:27:10 UTC. 80,000 wETH bridged out — the single largest leg of the theft.
Wormhole, 18:34:18 UTC. 16,879 wETH swapped on Solana for 269,356 SOL. A very large, very lopsided swap by a wallet that had held nothing an hour earlier.
Wormhole, 18:34:48 UTC. 7,504 wETH swapped for 18,044,852 USDC.
Wormhole, 18:35:36 UTC. The 18,044,852 USDC leaves the attacker's wallet.
Mango Markets, 2022-10-11 19:36:47 UTC. 24,838 USDC arrives at the attack wallet from an exchange address, three hours before the manipulation. The wallet's first funding.
Mango Markets, 22:08:07 UTC. The attack wallet calls the Mango v3 program (mv3ekLzLbnVPNxjSKvqBpU3ZeZXPQdEC3bp5MDEBG68) while holding 5.5M USDC. Position work, not a transfer.

Mango Markets, 22:33:20 UTC. 50,000 USDC swapped through Jupiter for 210,545 MNGO — one leg of the open-market buying that lifted the oracle-reported MNGO price and created the collateral the borrow was made against.
Mango Markets, 23:01:24 UTC. 1,049,584 USDC arrives at the attack wallet, which is by now holding 54M — the borrowed funds are already out of the protocol.
Mango Markets, 23:17:38 UTC. 20,000,000 USDC leaves the attack wallet in one transfer its owner signed.
Mango Markets, 23:19:17 UTC. 25,000,000 more USDC leaves, again owner-signed. The wallet is left holding 7.5M.
